KERNEL.gloss: the inner and usually edible part of a seed or grain or nut or fruit stone
KERNEL.definition: The inner and usually edible part of a seed or grain or nut or fruit stone.
KERNEL.example: Black walnut kernels are difficult to get out of the shell.

KNEEL.gloss: rest one's weight on one's knees
KNEEL.definition: Rest one's weight on one's knees.
KNEEL.example: In church you have to kneel during parts of the service.

KNEE.gloss: hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and…
KNEE.definition: Hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella.

KEEN.gloss: having or demonstrating ability to recognize or draw fine distinctions
KEEN.definition: Having or demonstrating ability to recognize or draw fine distinctions.
KEEN.example: An acute observer of politics and politicians.

REEL.gloss: walk as if unable to control one's movements
REEL.definition: Walk as if unable to control one's movements.
REEL.example: The drunken man staggered into the room.

KEN.gloss: range of what one can know or understand
KEN.definition: Range of what one can know or understand.

KEEL.gloss: a projection or ridge that suggests a keel
KEEL.definition: A projection or ridge that suggests a keel.
